Malicious operations using AI models, by how long each ran, log scale
Lines: published ranges; one bound assumed where a report gives only one. Arrows: still running. Of the nine cut off, three or four
went within a month (estimated share 41%, 22–62%) and four lasted six months or more. Only cases caught and disclosed appear.
Sources: Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft and Google threat reports; SentinelOne; CrowdStrike; Amazon; Krebs on Security; Cato
Networks; Abnormal Security; KELA; author's beta-binomial estimate (in note; 80% credible interval)
